headline: MIA @ STL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIA 4.92 at STL 4.18, with a projected total of 9.11. The projected total climbed +0.50, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -12.5%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Batter research is strongest for Lars Nootbaar, Otto Lopez, Masyn Winn, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jimmy Crooks because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
